extracted.intended_audience: meta-researchers, clinical trialists, journal editors, and others interested in trial registration and outcome reporting
extracted.subtask_description: A meta-research project evaluating how completely randomized clinical trials (RCTs) published in core ICMJE journals define and report outcomes in their ClinicalTrials.gov registrations, and related registration practices (timing, timeframes, result reporting, actual dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective registration of RCTs
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the proportion of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) published in core ICMJE journals that were registered prospectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The project will identify whether each RCT was registered before enrollment began (i.e., prospectively) and report the proportion meeting this criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness of outcome definitions on ClinicalTrials.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the proportion of RCTs that defined their outcomes completely on ClinicalTrials.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess individual registry entries to judge whether outcome measures are defined with sufficient detail (as per the study's operationalization) and report the proportion of trials with complete outcome definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorization of Timeframe field information
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorize information entered in the Timeframe field of ClinicalTrials.gov registry entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and classify the types of data provided in the Timeframe field (e.g., descriptive text, date ranges, planned vs. actual timeframes) to understand how time-related outcome details are reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting of results on ClinicalTrials.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the proportion of RCTs in core ICMJE journals that report results on ClinicalTrials.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For trials included in the sample, check whether results summary information has been posted to ClinicalTrials.gov and report the proportion with posted results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating registry records with 'actual' study start and primary completion dates before publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the proportion of RCTs that update their ClinicalTrials.gov records to include 'actual' study start and primary completion dates prior to publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess registry entries for updates that replace planned dates with actual study start and primary completion dates, and quantify how often this occurs before the related trial's publication.
